        arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        arState_x[iLoopZone] := 25.0;       (* Initial ambient bed temp assumption *)
        arState_x_pred[iLoopZone] := 25.0;
        arMeas_y[iLoopZone] := 25.0;
        arSubSurfaceTemp_C[iLoopZone] := 25.0;
        arCompensatedEmissivity[iLoopZone] := 0.920;
        arSinterDegree[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        aChannelHealth_A[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        aChannelHealth_B[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        aChannelHealth_C[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := FALSE;
        aSensorIsolated[iLoopZone] := FALSE;
        aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] := 0;
        aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] := 0;
        aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] := 0;
        arSensorDrift_A[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        arSensorDrift_B[iLoopZone] := 0.0;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 1: HARDWARE SAFETY INTERLOCKS & SIL-3 STATUS EVALUATION
   Immediate zero-power latch upon E-Stop trip, chamber breach, or severe overpressure
   =========================================================================================== *)
IF bResetFault THEN
    dwFaultMask := 16#00000000;
    dwWarningMask := 16#00000000;
    bInterlockTripped := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Safety Interlock 1: Dual Channel Emergency Stop Circuit *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Hardware E-Stop Tripped *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Safety Interlock 2: Process Chamber Door Seal & Vacuum Integrity *)
IF NOT bChamberDoorInterlock THEN
    dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Chamber Door Open / Seal Lost *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Safety Interlock 3: Chamber Atmospheric Overpressure Protection *)
IF (rChamberPressure_mbar > 1080.0) OR (rChamberPressure_mbar < 950.0) THEN
    dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Chamber Differential Pressure Trip *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Safety Interlock 4: Residual Oxygen Contamination in Nitrogen Environment *)
(* Critical for PEEK @ 380 C to prevent auto-ignition and rapid polymer oxidation *)
IF rChamberO2Level_ppm > 85.0 THEN
    dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Oxygen Breakthrough Fault *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
ELSIF rChamberO2Level_ppm > 45.0 THEN
    dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000001; (* Warning Bit 0: O2 Level Elevated *)
END_IF;

(* Safety Interlock 5: Upstream Mains Electrical Bus Capacity Violation *)
IF rTotalAvailableMainsPower_kW < 12.0 THEN
    dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Insufficient Grid Bus Power *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Safety Interlock 6: Substrate Boundary Strain Exceeds Critical Failure Yield *)
rStrainPeak := 0.0;
FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 4 DO
    IF ABS(rBedFrameStrain_microstrain[iLoopZone]) > rStrainPeak THEN
        rStrainPeak := ABS(rBedFrameStrain_microstrain[iLoopZone]);
    END_IF;
END_FOR;
IF rStrainPeak > 1400.0 THEN
    dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Critical Substrate Warpage Yield *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
ELSIF rStrainPeak > 650.0 THEN
    dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000002; (* Warning Bit 1: High Substrate Stress *)
END_IF;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANT (TMR) PYROMETER VOTING & FDI ENGINE
   Performs pairwise residual comparison, median voting, channel isolation, and drift tracking
   =========================================================================================== *)
FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
    (* Compute Pairwise Differences Between Redundant Optical Channels *)
    rDiffA_B := ABS(rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] - rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone]);
    rDiffB_C := ABS(rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] - rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone]);
    rDiffA_C := ABS(rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] - rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone]);

    (* Channel A Health Validation & Debounce *)
    IF (rDiffA_B > rTMR_CRITICAL_DEV_C) AND (rDiffA_C > rTMR_CRITICAL_DEV_C) THEN
        aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] := aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] + 1;
        IF aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] >= iTmrFaultDebounceLimit THEN
            aChannelHealth_A[iLoopZone] := FALSE; (* Isolate Channel A *)
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] > 0 THEN
            aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] := aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] - 1;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Channel B Health Validation & Debounce *)
    IF (rDiffA_B > rTMR_CRITICAL_DEV_C) AND (rDiffB_C > rTMR_CRITICAL_DEV_C) THEN
        aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] := aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] + 1;
        IF aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] >= iTmrFaultDebounceLimit THEN
            aChannelHealth_B[iLoopZone] := FALSE; (* Isolate Channel B *)
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] > 0 THEN
            aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] := aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] - 1;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Channel C Health Validation & Debounce *)
    IF (rDiffA_C > rTMR_CRITICAL_DEV_C) AND (rDiffB_C > rTMR_CRITICAL_DEV_C) THEN
        aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] := aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] + 1;
        IF aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] >= iTmrFaultDebounceLimit THEN
            aChannelHealth_C[iLoopZone] := FALSE; (* Isolate Channel C *)
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] > 0 THEN
            aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] := aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] - 1;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Deterministic Voting Selection Logic *)
    IF aChannelHealth_A[iLoopZone] AND aChannelHealth_B[iLoopZone] AND aChannelHealth_C[iLoopZone] THEN
        (* Full 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy Nominal Mode - Median Selection *)
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := FALSE;
        aSensorIsolated[iLoopZone] := FALSE;
        (* Find median of three values *)
        IF ((rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] >= rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone]) AND (rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] <= rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone])) OR
           ((rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] <= rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone]) AND (rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] >= rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone])) THEN
            rMedianVal := rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone];
        ELSIF ((rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] >= rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone]) AND (rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] <= rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone])) OR
              ((rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] <= rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone]) AND (rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] >= rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone])) THEN
            rMedianVal := rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone];
        ELSE
            rMedianVal := rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone];
        END_IF;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := rMedianVal;

        (* Update Continuous Sensor Drift Accumulators *)
        arSensorDrift_A[iLoopZone] := 0.995 * arSensorDrift_A[iLoopZone] + 0.005 * (rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] - rMedianVal);
        arSensorDrift_B[iLoopZone] := 0.995 * arSensorDrift_B[iLoopZone] + 0.005 * (rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] - rMedianVal);
        arSensorDrift_C[iLoopZone] := 0.995 * arSensorDrift_C[iLoopZone] + 0.005 * (rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone] - rMedianVal);
    ELSIF aChannelHealth_A[iLoopZone] AND aChannelHealth_B[iLoopZone] THEN
        (* Degraded 1oo2 Redundancy: Average Channels A & B *)
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := 0.5 * (rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] + rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone]);
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000004; (* Channel C Faulted *)
    ELSIF aChannelHealth_B[iLoopZone] AND aChannelHealth_C[iLoopZone] THEN
        (* Degraded 1oo2 Redundancy: Average Channels B & C *)
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := 0.5 * (rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] + rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone]);
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000008; (* Channel A Faulted *)
    ELSIF aChannelHealth_A[iLoopZone] AND aChannelHealth_C[iLoopZone] THEN
        (* Degraded 1oo2 Redundancy: Average Channels A & C *)
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := 0.5 * (rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] + rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone]);
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000010; (* Channel B Faulted *)
    ELSIF aChannelHealth_A[iLoopZone] THEN
        (* Degraded Simplex 1oo1 Mode: Single Channel A *)
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone];
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000020; (* Critical Simplex Mode *)
    ELSIF aChannelHealth_B[iLoopZone] THEN
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone];
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000020;
    ELSIF aChannelHealth_C[iLoopZone] THEN
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone];
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000020;
    ELSE
        (* All redundant channels failed in zone: Fallback to State-Space Observer *)
        aSensorIsolated[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := arState_x_pred[iLoopZone];
        dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Total Zone Sensor Blindness *)
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 3: IN-SITU THERMOGRAPHIC EMISSIVITY & PLANCK RADIANCE COMPENSATION
   Compensates for phase transition (powder to melt pool) and reflected ambient cavity radiance
   =========================================================================================== *)
FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
    (* Estimate localized sintering state based on cumulative thermal exposure above melting *)
    IF arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] > (rT_Melt_C - 10.0) THEN
        arSinterDegree[iLoopZone] := arSinterDegree[iLoopZone] + 0.0004 * (arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] - (rT_Melt_C - 10.0)) * rCycleTime_s;
        IF arSinterDegree[iLoopZone] > 1.0 THEN
            arSinterDegree[iLoopZone] := 1.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSIF bRecoaterActive THEN
        (* Fresh cold powder deposition resets surface sintering degree to zero loose powder *)
        arSinterDegree[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Dynamic Emissivity Formulation: *)
    (* Loose porous powder: high cavity emissivity ~ 0.935 *)
    (* Consolidated liquid polymer pool: lower specular emissivity ~ 0.845 *)
    (* Temperature coefficient alpha_T: -0.00008 / K *)
    rApparentEmissivity := 0.9350 - (0.0900 * arSinterDegree[iLoopZone]) - (0.000085 * (arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] - 25.0));
    IF rApparentEmissivity < 0.780 THEN
        rApparentEmissivity := 0.780;
    ELSIF rApparentEmissivity > 0.965 THEN
        rApparentEmissivity := 0.965;
    END_IF;
    arCompensatedEmissivity[iLoopZone] := rApparentEmissivity;

    (* Convert Voted Apparent Temperature to Kelvin *)
    rT_Kelvin := arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] + rABS_ZERO_OFFSET_C;
    IF rT_Kelvin < 273.15 THEN
        rT_Kelvin := 273.15;
    END_IF;

    (* Stefan-Boltzmann Blackbody Spectral Radiance Approximation: E_bb = sigma * T^4 *)
    rRadiance_BB := rSTEFAN_BOLTZMANN * EXPT(rT_Kelvin, 4);
    arRawRadiance_Wm2sr[iLoopZone] := rRadiance_BB;

    (* Background Reflected Radiance from Heated Walls and Halogen Tube Filaments *)
    rRadiance_Refl := rSTEFAN_BOLTZMANN * EXPT(rHeatedWallTemp_C + rABS_ZERO_OFFSET_C, 4);
    arReflectedRadiance_Wm2sr[iLoopZone] := rRadiance_Refl;

    (* True Surface Radiance Inversion: L_true = (L_raw - (1 - eps)*L_refl) / eps *)
    rTempSum := (rRadiance_BB - ((1.0 - rApparentEmissivity) * rRadiance_Refl)) / rApparentEmissivity;
    IF rTempSum < 10.0 THEN
        rTempSum := 10.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Compute Thermodynamic Surface Temperature: T_s = (L_true / sigma)^0.25 - 273.15 *)
    arSurfaceTrueTemp_C[iLoopZone] := SQRT(SQRT(rTempSum / rSTEFAN_BOLTZMANN)) - rABS_ZERO_OFFSET_C;
    (* Kalman Filter Measurement Fusion with State-Space Model *)
    arState_x[iLoopZone] := 0.88 * arSurfaceTrueTemp_C[iLoopZone] + 0.12 * arState_x_pred[iLoopZone];
    rEstimatedSurfaceTemp_C[iLoopZone] := arState_x[iLoopZone];
END_FOR;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 4: 2D DISCRETE LAPLACIAN SPATIAL GRADIENTS & BOUNDARY WARPAGE METRICS
   Calculates in-plane thermal stress and generates perimeter halo compensation offsets
   =========================================================================================== *)
rMaxGradFound := 0.0;
rMaxStressFound := 0.0;
rTempSum := 0.0;

FOR iLoopRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    FOR iLoopCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        iLoopZone := (iLoopRow - 1) * 4 + iLoopCol;
        rCenterTemp := arState_x[iLoopZone];
        rTempSum := rTempSum + rCenterTemp;

        (* Boundary Value Handling for 2D Spatial Derivatives *)
        (* North neighbor *)
        IF iLoopRow > 1 THEN
            rNorthTemp := arState_x[iLoopZone - 4];
        ELSE
            rNorthTemp := rHeatedWallTemp_C; (* Heat sink wall boundary *)
        END_IF;
        (* South neighbor *)
        IF iLoopRow < 4 THEN
            rSouthTemp := arState_x[iLoopZone + 4];
        ELSE
            rSouthTemp := rHeatedWallTemp_C;
        END_IF;
        (* West neighbor *)
        IF iLoopCol > 1 THEN
            rWestTemp := arState_x[iLoopZone - 1];
        ELSE
            rWestTemp := rHeatedWallTemp_C;
        END_IF;
        (* East neighbor *)
        IF iLoopCol < 4 THEN
            rEastTemp := arState_x[iLoopZone + 1];
        ELSE
            rEastTemp := rHeatedWallTemp_C;
        END_IF;

        (* Discrete 2D Laplacian: Del^2 T = (T_N + T_S + T_E + T_W - 4*T_C) / (dx^2) *)
        arLaplacian2D_C_m2[iLoopZone] := (rNorthTemp + rSouthTemp + rEastTemp + rWestTemp - (4.0 * rCenterTemp)) / EXPT(rZONE_WIDTH_MM / 1000.0, 2);

        (* Max Directional Gradient Evaluation [deg C / mm] *)
        IF (ABS(rCenterTemp - rNorthTemp) / rZONE_WIDTH_MM) > rMaxGradFound THEN
            rMaxGradFound := ABS(rCenterTemp - rNorthTemp) / rZONE_WIDTH_MM;
        END_IF;
        IF (ABS(rCenterTemp - rEastTemp) / rZONE_WIDTH_MM) > rMaxGradFound THEN
            rMaxGradFound := ABS(rCenterTemp - rEastTemp) / rZONE_WIDTH_MM;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

rAverageBedTemp_C := rTempSum / 16.0;
rMaxThermalGradient_C_mm := rMaxGradFound;

(* Evaluate In-Plane Thermoelastic Contraction Stress: sigma = (E * alpha / (1 - nu)) * (T_avg - T_local) *)
FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
    arThermalStress_MPa[iLoopZone] := (rPolymerElasticModulus_MPa * (rPolymerCTE_ppmK * 1.0E-06) / (1.0 - rPoissonRatio)) *
                                     ABS(rAverageBedTemp_C - arState_x[iLoopZone]);
    IF arThermalStress_MPa[iLoopZone] > rMaxStressFound THEN
        rMaxStressFound := arThermalStress_MPa[iLoopZone];
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Compute Dimensionless Warpage Risk Index [0.0 to 1.0] *)
(* Combines maximum thermal stress with piezoresistive substrate physical strain sensors *)
rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex := (0.55 * (rMaxStressFound / 18.5)) + (0.45 * (rStrainPeak / 1200.0));
IF rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex > 1.0 THEN
    rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex := 1.0;
ELSIF rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex < 0.0 THEN
    rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Boundary-to-Core Gradient Divergence *)
rCoreAverageTemp := 0.25 * (arState_x[6] + arState_x[7] + arState_x[10] + arState_x[11]);
rPerimeterAverageTemp := 0.0833 * (arState_x[1] + arState_x[2] + arState_x[3] + arState_x[4] +
                                  arState_x[5] + arState_x[8] + arState_x[9] + arState_x[12] +
                                  arState_x[13] + arState_x[14] + arState_x[15] + arState_x[16]);
rBoundaryGradientDelta := rCoreAverageTemp - rPerimeterAverageTemp;

(* Dynamic Perimeter Halo Heating Compensation *)
(* Counteracts radiant loss to colder chamber walls and prevents part edge crystallization curl *)
FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
    IF (iLoopZone = 1) OR (iLoopZone = 4) OR (iLoopZone = 13) OR (iLoopZone = 16) THEN
        (* Corner zones experience highest solid-angle cold wall view factor *)
        arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.024 * rBoundaryGradientDelta + (0.085 * rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex);
    ELSIF (iLoopZone = 2) OR (iLoopZone = 3) OR (iLoopZone = 5) OR (iLoopZone = 8) OR
          (iLoopZone = 9) OR (iLoopZone = 12) OR (iLoopZone = 14) OR (iLoopZone = 15) THEN
        (* Perimeter edge zones *)
        arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.015 * rBoundaryGradientDelta + (0.045 * rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex);
    ELSE
        (* Core zones - zero offset *)
        arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 5: RECOATER BLADE KINEMATIC THERMAL SHOCK DISTURBANCE FEEDFORWARD
   Preempts localized enthalpy extraction as cold powder layer is spread across 380 C bed
   =========================================================================================== *)
IF bRecoaterActive AND (rRecoaterVelocity_mms > 5.0) THEN
    (* Calculate Normalized Blade Position Across Bed Length [0.0 to 1.0] *)
    rBladePassProgressNormalized := rRecoaterPosition_mm / rBED_TOTAL_WIDTH_MM;
    IF rBladePassProgressNormalized < 0.0 THEN
        rBladePassProgressNormalized := 0.0;
    ELSIF rBladePassProgressNormalized > 1.0 THEN
        rBladePassProgressNormalized := 1.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Compute Layer Enthalpy Deficit per Zone: Delta H = rho * Cp * Area * Thickness * (T_bed - T_hopper) *)
    rBladeThermalQuenchEnthalpy_J := (rPowderBulkDensity_kgm3 * rPowderSpecificHeat_JkgK *
                                     rZONE_AREA_M2 * (rPowderLayerThickness_um * 1.0E-06) *
                                     (rSetpointTempBed_C - rAmbientHopperTemp_C));

    (* Compute Dynamic Spatial Feedforward Radiative Pulse *)
    (* Applies a moving Gaussian heat injection wave centered on the advancing blade *)
    FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
        rDistDiff := ABS(arZoneCentroidX_mm[iLoopZone] - rRecoaterPosition_mm);
        (* Gaussian spatial distribution kernel with sigma = 45.0 mm *)
        rWeightGauss := EXP(-EXPT(rDistDiff / 45.0, 2));

        (* Feedforward power injection proportional to blade velocity and quench enthalpy *)
        arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone] := (rBladeThermalQuenchEnthalpy_J / 1250.0) *
                                              (rRecoaterVelocity_mms / 150.0) * rWeightGauss;
        IF arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone] > 0.850 THEN
            arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.850; (* Actuator saturation cap *)
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
ELSE
    (* Recoater stationary: smooth decay of feedforward registers to zero *)
    FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
        arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.85 * arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone];
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 6: LASER EXPOSURE LOCALIZED THERMAL COMPENSATION
   Calculates back-radiation thermal offset under the active galvanometer laser scanning spot
   =========================================================================================== *)
IF bLaserScanningActive AND (rLaserPower_W > 10.0) THEN
    FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
        rDistToLaser_mm := SQRT(EXPT(arZoneCentroidX_mm[iLoopZone] - rLaserSpotPositionX_mm, 2) +
                                EXPT(arZoneCentroidY_mm[iLoopZone] - rLaserSpotPositionY_mm, 2));
        IF rDistToLaser_mm < 60.0 THEN
            rLaserKernel := 1.0 - (rDistToLaser_mm / 60.0);
            (* Back off halogen lamp power locally to prevent polymer thermal degradation *)
            arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone] := arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone] - ((rLaserPower_W / 1000.0) * 0.42 * rLaserKernel);
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 7: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE PREDICTOR & MEASUREMENT EQUATION (A, B, C, D, E)
   x(k+1) = A * x(k) + B * u(k) + E * d(k)
   y(k)   = C * x(k) + D * u(k)
   =========================================================================================== *)
FOR iLoopRow := 1 TO 16 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    (* Inter-zone conduction and self-cooling: A * x *)
    FOR iLoopCol := 1 TO 16 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (mA[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] * arState_x[iLoopCol]);
    END_FOR;

    (* Radiant flux input coupling: B * u *)
    rPowerSum := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopCol := 1 TO 16 DO
        rPowerSum := rPowerSum + (mB[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] * arU_Current_kW[iLoopCol] * 12.85);
    END_FOR;

    (* Disturbance coupling: E * d *)
    rLaserDisturbancePower := 0.0;
    IF bLaserScanningActive THEN
        rLaserDisturbancePower := rLaserPower_W;
    END_IF;
    rTempSum := rTempSum + rPowerSum + (mE[iLoopRow, 1] * arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopRow] * 2.5) +
                (mE[iLoopRow, 2] * rLaserDisturbancePower * 0.01);

    arState_x_pred[iLoopRow] := rTempSum;

    (* Compute Sensor Output Measurement Model: y = C * x + D * u *)
    arMeas_y[iLoopRow] := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopCol := 1 TO 16 DO
        arMeas_y[iLoopRow] := arMeas_y[iLoopRow] + (mC[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] * arState_x[iLoopCol]) +
                               (mD[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] * arU_Current_kW[iLoopCol]);
    END_FOR;

    (* Update sub-surface powder node via vertical 1D Fourier conduction *)
    arSubSurfaceTemp_C[iLoopRow] := 0.985 * arSubSurfaceTemp_C[iLoopRow] + 0.015 * arState_x[iLoopRow];
END_FOR;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 8: CONSTRAINED MPC SOLVER - PROJECTED GRADIENT DESCENT (PGD)
   Minimizes tracking error, slew rates, spatial curvature, and respects total mains power budget
   =========================================================================================== *)
IF (iState = 50) OR (iState = 60) OR (iState = 70) OR (iState = 80) THEN
    (* Initialize optimization iterate with current active power *)
    FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
        arU_Optimal_kW[iLoopZone] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone];
    END_FOR;

    (* PGD Iteration Loop *)
    FOR iLoopIter := 1 TO iMPC_MaxIterations DO
        (* Compute Cost Function Gradient: grad_u J = B^T * Q * (x_pred - x_ref) + R * u + R_lap * Lap *)
        FOR iLoopCol := 1 TO 16 DO
            rGradTerm := 0.0;
            FOR iLoopRow := 1 TO 16 DO
                rTempError := arState_x_pred[iLoopRow] - rSetpointTempBed_C;
                rGradTerm := rGradTerm + (mB[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] * arQ_Weights[iLoopRow] * rTempError * 0.085);
            END_FOR;
            (* Regularization on control effort magnitude and warpage Laplacian *)
            rGradTerm := rGradTerm + (arR_Weights[iLoopCol] * arU_Optimal_kW[iLoopCol]) -
                         (rWarpageLaplacianPenalty * arLaplacian2D_C_m2[iLoopCol] * 0.002);
            arGradJ[iLoopCol] := rGradTerm;
        END_FOR;

        (* Gradient Step & Projection onto Box Constraints [rLAMP_MIN_PREHEAT_KW, rLAMP_MAX_POWER_KW] *)
        FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
            rStepCandidate := arU_Optimal_kW[iLoopZone] - (rMPC_StepSize_Alpha * arGradJ[iLoopZone]);
            (* Clamp to physical actuator box limits *)
            IF rStepCandidate > rLAMP_MAX_POWER_KW THEN
                rStepCandidate := rLAMP_MAX_POWER_KW;
            ELSIF rStepCandidate < rLAMP_MIN_PREHEAT_KW THEN
                rStepCandidate := rLAMP_MIN_PREHEAT_KW;
            END_IF;
            arU_Optimal_kW[iLoopZone] := rStepCandidate;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Apply Slew Rate Limiting & Disturbance Injections *)
    rTotalPowerRequested_kW := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
        (* Add Feedforward Recoater Shock Rejection and Boundary Warpage Halo Offset *)
        rStepCandidate := arU_Optimal_kW[iLoopZone] + arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone] + arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone];

        (* Slew Rate Limiting *)
        rSlewDelta := rStepCandidate - arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone];
        IF rSlewDelta > (rLAMP_MAX_SLEW_RATE_KW_PER_S * rCycleTime_s) THEN
            rSlewDelta := rLAMP_MAX_SLEW_RATE_KW_PER_S * rCycleTime_s;
        ELSIF rSlewDelta < (-rLAMP_MAX_SLEW_RATE_KW_PER_S * rCycleTime_s) THEN
            rSlewDelta := -rLAMP_MAX_SLEW_RATE_KW_PER_S * rCycleTime_s;
        END_IF;
        arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] + rSlewDelta;

        (* Re-check Box Constraints *)
        IF arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] > rLAMP_MAX_POWER_KW THEN
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := rLAMP_MAX_POWER_KW;
        ELSIF arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] < rLAMP_MIN_PREHEAT_KW THEN
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := rLAMP_MIN_PREHEAT_KW;
        END_IF;
        rTotalPowerRequested_kW := rTotalPowerRequested_kW + arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone];
    END_FOR;

    (* Global Electrical Mains Power Budget Enforcement (Hyperplane Projection) *)
    IF rTotalPowerRequested_kW > rTotalAvailableMainsPower_kW THEN
        rPowerScalingFactor := rTotalAvailableMainsPower_kW / rTotalPowerRequested_kW;
        FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] * rPowerScalingFactor;
        END_FOR;
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000040; (* Warning Bit 6: Mains Power Clipped *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ===========================================================================================

        (* Dynamically distribute lost radiative flux to 4 immediate neighbors *)
        rCurrentPowerAlloc_kW := arU_Optimal_kW[iLoopZone] * 0.235;

            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone - 4] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone - 4] + rCurrentPowerAlloc_kW;

        IF (iLoopZone + 4) <= 16 THEN

        IF ((iLoopZone - 1) >= 1) AND ((iLoopZone MOD 4) <> 1) THEN
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone - 1] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone - 1] + rCurrentPowerAlloc_kW;
        END_IF;
        IF ((iLoopZone + 1) <= 16) AND ((iLoopZone MOD 4) <> 0) THEN
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone + 1] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone + 1] + rCurrentPowerAlloc_kW;

   =========================================================================================== *)
rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_SAFE_OFF: Complete system quiescent standby *)
        bReadyForDosing := FALSE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := FALSE;

        bReadyForDosing := FALSE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := FALSE;

            iState := 99;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;

            IF (arVotedTemp_C[1] > 5.0) AND (arVotedTemp_C[1] < 55.0) THEN
                iState := 20; (* Advance to inerting check *)
                rStateTimer_s := 0.0;

                iState := 99;

        bReadyForDosing := FALSE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := FALSE;

            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        ELSIF (rChamberO2Level_ppm < 40.0) AND (rChamberPressure_mbar >= 1005.0) THEN
            iState := 30; (* Advance to filament preheat soft-start *)
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        ELSIF rStateTimer_s > 180.0 THEN
            dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000100; (* Purge Timeout Fault *)
            iState := 99;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;

        bReadyForDosing := FALSE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := FALSE;
        FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := rLAMP_MIN_PREHEAT_KW;
        END_FOR;

            iState := 99;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;

        bReadyForDosing := FALSE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := FALSE;

        rRampTargetTemp_C := rRampTargetTemp_C + (rRampRate_C_per_min / 60.0) * rCycleTime_s;
        IF rRampTargetTemp_C >= rSetpointTempBed_C THEN
            rRampTargetTemp_C := rSetpointTempBed_C;

            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        (* Feedforward ramp power baseline *)
        FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.45 + (0.0038 * rRampTargetTemp_C) + arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone];
            IF arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] > rLAMP_MAX_POWER_KW THEN
                arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := rLAMP_MAX_POWER_KW;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF bInterlockTripped THEN
            iState := 99;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_THERMAL_EQUILIBRIUM_SOAK: Settle spatial gradients prior to layer spreading *)
        bReadyForDosing := FALSE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := FALSE;

        IF (ABS(rAverageBedTemp_C - rSetpointTempBed_C) < 1.50) AND (rMaxThermalGradient_C_mm < 0.035) THEN
            IF rStateTimer_s > 60.0 THEN
                iState := 60; (* Bed is completely isothermal and ready for sintering operations *)
                rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            IF rStateTimer_s > 600.0 THEN
                dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000100; (* Soak Equilibrium Prolonged *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
        IF bInterlockTripped THEN
            iState := 99;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;

        bReadyForDosing := TRUE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := TRUE;
        IF bRecoaterActive THEN
            iState := 70; (* Recoater traverse in progress: switch to feedforward quench rejection *)
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        ELSIF bLaserScanningActive THEN
            iState := 80; (* Laser active: switch to laser offset compensation *)
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        ELSIF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iState := 90; (* User shutdown: advance to controlled anneal cooldown *)
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        ELSIF bInterlockTripped THEN
            iState := 99;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_RECOATER_PASS_FEEDFORWARD: High-speed feedforward rejection during powder spreading *)
        bReadyForDosing := TRUE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := FALSE; (* Inhibit laser during physical recoater traverse *)
        IF NOT bRecoaterActive THEN
            iState := 60; (* Blade traverse complete: return to closed-loop equilibrium *)
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        ELSIF bInterlockTripped THEN
            iState := 99;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_LASER_EXPOSURE_OFFSET: Optical energy compensation during galvo laser hatching *)
        bReadyForDosing := FALSE; (* Inhibit recoater blade during active laser sintering *)
        bReadyForLaserExposure := TRUE;
        IF NOT bLaserScanningActive THEN
            iState := 60; (* Exposure slice complete: return to normal equilibrium *)
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        ELSIF bInterlockTripped THEN
            iState := 99;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_COOLING_CRYSTALLIZATION: Controlled slow anneal ramp to prevent warpage *)
        bReadyForDosing := FALSE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := FALSE;
        (* Slowly decrease setpoint at controlled cooling rate [C/min] *)
        rSetpointTempBed_C := rSetpointTempBed_C - (rCoolingRampRate_C_per_min / 60.0) * rCycleTime_s;
        IF rSetpointTempBed_C <= (rT_Glass_Trans_C - 20.0) THEN
            iState := 0; (* Polymer fully vitrified below Tg: safe to power down completely *)
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        IF bInterlockTripped THEN
            iState := 99;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_FAILSAFE_EMERGENCY_DEGRADATION: Hardware trip or sensor blackout safe shutdown *)
        bReadyForDosing := FALSE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := FALSE;
        FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        IF bResetFault AND NOT bInterlockTripped THEN
            iState := 0; (* Reset back to standby *)
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 11: ACTUATOR OUTPUT MAPPING, FLUX CALCULATIONS & STATUS CODES
   Delivers final thyristor power demands, computes net radiative flux, and sets status words
   =========================================================================================== *)

    rHalogenOutputPower_kW[iLoopZone] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone];
    rPowerSum := rPowerSum + arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone];

    (* Compute Delivered Radiative Energy Flux Incident on Powder Bed [W/m2] *)
    (* E_eff = (Power_kW * 1000 * Optical_Efficiency) / Zone_Area_m2 *)
    rEffectiveFluxField_Wm2[iLoopZone] := (arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] * 1000.0 * 0.885) / rZONE_AREA_M2;

rTotalConsumedPower_kW := rPowerSum;
iActiveState := iState;

END_IF;
IF bInterlockTripped THEN

END_IF;
IF bReadyForDosing THEN

END_IF;
IF bReadyForLaserExposure THEN

END_IF;
IF bRecoaterActive THEN

END_IF;
IF bLaserScanningActive THEN

END_IF;

END_IF;

END_IF;
IF (dwWarningMask <> 16#00000000) THEN

END_IF;
